title: Colonel Mary Louise Rasmuson Campus of the Alaska VA Healthcare System Act of 2022
official_summary:
Colonel Mary Louise Rasmuson Campus of the Alaska VA Healthcare System Act of 2022

This act designates the medical center of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Anchorage, Alaska, as the Colonel Mary Louise Rasmuson Campus of the Alaska VA Healthcare System.

summary.headline: A law that names a VA medical center in Anchorage, Alaska, after Colonel Mary Louise Rasmuson.
summary.what_it_does: The law renames the Department of Veterans Affairs medical center in Anchorage, Alaska, as the Colonel Mary Louise Rasmuson Campus of the Alaska VA Healthcare System. It changes only the name of the facility. The summary does not describe any change to services, staffing, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2023.
